implementation.name: sqrl_bridge_rawjtag_coe
source_evidence: Sidecar scripts invoke sqrl_bridge_rawjtag_coe with -j <port> to enable XVC
ELF exports SQCoEStartXVC and _xvcThread and retains debug module name sqrl_xvc.cpp
No corresponding SQRL XVC C/C++ implementation source found locally
Current testbench binary hash not freshly checked; no SSH performed
implementation.handler_effect: read 9 bytes after initial 2-byte command prefix, copy value DWORD, write identical 4 bytes; no clock configuration update

settck.request_format: ASCII 'settck:' followed by uint32 little-endian period field
settck.response_format: the same 4 period bytes echoed unchanged
settck.value_semantics: XVC period in nanoseconds by protocol convention; opaque uint32 copy in this handler

clock_configuration.rate_source: FTDI MPSSE initialization in SQRL bridge binary
clock_configuration.calculation: divisor = floor(30000000 / requested_clock) - 1; command bytes include 0x97, 0x8a, 0x86, divisor low/high

answers.sidecar_request_period_capability: The protocol lets a client send a period value, but this handler only echoes it and does not apply it
answers.minimum_physical_tck_test: Freshly attest the selected endpoint's SQRL ELF hash; capture one authorized settck exchange; issue a bounded known JTAG clock pattern; measure TCK at adapter pins; verify exclusive client access across disconnect/reconnect.

offline_model.model_scope: pinned-binary behavior only; never opens sockets or transport

elf.ftdi_d2xx_and_libusb_linkage: implemented symbols found in ELF; not DT_NEEDED dynamic libraries

provenance.conclusion: retained FK33 bridge artifact and launcher usage proven; deployed remote executable identity conditional/unproven

xvc_handlers.settck_value_storage: uint32 copied as native little-endian on x86-64
xvc_handlers.shift: read uint32 bit count, ceil(bits/8) TMS and TDI bit vectors; raw SQRL TMS/chain shifts; return captured TDO bytes

mpsse_clock_forensics.called_from: SQRLJtagCreate called in addDevice during device setup

derived_contract.XVC_BINARY_PROVEN_NOTE: False means the exact currently deployed remote binary hash is unproven; the retained FK33 artifact and its use by the launcher are documented.

minimum_future_physical_measurement.precondition: later separately authorized, exact executable hash verified, endpoint idle and exclusive peer access
minimum_future_physical_measurement.probe: adapter TCK/SK output to adapter ground
minimum_future_physical_measurement.capture: adapter TCK/SK to ground; idle plus a bounded documented read-only IDCODE scan; record high/low periods, frequency, probe point, instrument/sample settings, and binary hash
minimum_future_physical_measurement.avoid: FPGA programming, bitstream change, mining change, USER instruction change; do not treat settck echo as rate measurement
minimum_future_physical_measurement.caveat: ordinary XVC shift carries scan semantics; use reviewed adapter-side clock-only or TAP-preserving no-op pattern
minimum_future_physical_measurement.procedure: verify the target IDCODE instruction from its design documentation; perform one short read-only IDCODE scan under exclusive peer access; return TAP to Run-Test/Idle
minimum_future_physical_measurement.preserve: FPGA image and miner workload; select IDCODE, not USER1/USER2; no programming or image change
minimum_future_physical_measurement.settck_echo: optional capture for protocol evidence only; not rate readback
